description: Read-only Keeper MSP posture across every client, with history, a change feed and no path to a vault secret.

novel_features.name: Multi-company posture report
novel_features.description: Fetch 2FA coverage, weak and reused passwords, BreachWatch exposure, inactive users and seat usage for every managed company in one run, and record it.

novel_features.name: Posture diff between runs
novel_features.description: Compare two stored posture runs (needs two 'posture report' runs): per-company metric deltas and per-user transitions such as 2FA turned off or newly at risk.

novel_features.name: Change events feed
novel_features.description: Read posture change events (user.twofa_disabled, posture.weak_passwords_increased and more) after a cursor, once each.

novel_features.name: Cross-company user lookup
novel_features.description: Find which managed company a user belongs to, with status, 2FA and last login, across every client; reads the newest stored 'posture report' run (run it first).

novel_features.name: Account hygiene sweep
novel_features.description: List stale invites (with how long they have been pending), locked, inactive and pending-transfer users across every client; reads the newest stored 'posture report' run (run it first).

novel_features.name: User security exceptions
novel_features.description: List users without 2FA (admins outside any 2FA-enforcing role first), BreachWatch at-risk users and users with weak or reused passwords across every client; reads the newest stored 'posture report' run (run it first).

novel_features.name: Posture run history
novel_features.description: List stored posture runs with their time, status and inactivity window.

novel_features.name: Managed companies
novel_features.description: List every managed company with plan, seats allocated and active, storage and add-ons.

novel_features.name: One managed company
novel_features.description: Show one managed company's plan, seats and add-ons by id.

novel_features.name: MSP products and pricing
novel_features.description: List MSP products, add-ons and file plans with pricing.

novel_features.name: MSP permits
novel_features.description: Show which products and add-ons the MSP may allocate and the maximum file plan.

novel_features.name: Consumption billing statement
novel_features.description: Show the monthly consumption billing statement, optionally by company and by date.

novel_features.name: Users with status and 2FA
novel_features.description: List an enterprise's or a managed company's users with status, transfer status, node, roles and 2FA.

novel_features.name: Last login per user
novel_features.description: Show each user's last login within a window.

novel_features.name: Nodes
novel_features.description: List the enterprise node tree with user, team and role counts.

novel_features.name: Teams
novel_features.description: List teams with node and user count.

novel_features.name: Roles
novel_features.description: List roles with admin flag, default role, node and user count.

novel_features.name: Security audit
novel_features.description: Show each user's weak, fair, medium, strong, reused and unique password counts, security score and 2FA.

novel_features.name: BreachWatch summary
novel_features.description: Show each user's BreachWatch at-risk, passed and ignored counts.

novel_features.name: Audit trail events
novel_features.description: Read raw audit events, newest first, filtered by period, user and event type.

novel_features.name: Audit trail summary
novel_features.description: Count audit events by type per day, week, month or the whole period.

novel_features.name: Command allowlist
novel_features.description: Print the read-only Commander commands this CLI can send and the matching Service Mode -c value.
